reports.notes: THIS FILING USES THE COUNTY-ONLY TITLE: '2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' (no '& LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD'), with the sidebar reading 'COUNTY CANDIDATES' and the summary-page header '2014 County Candidate' - a different printing of the legacy form from the other 2014 filings in this tranche. Handwritten. The filer writes zeros as a slashed-zero glyph (lines 1A, 1B, 2A, 7) - actually-written zeros, transcribed 0 at medium confidence. Cents are written as a raised superscript ('65.' with superscript '00'), transcribed 65.00. NEGATIVE figures are written in accountant's parentheses on lines 3, 4 and 5 and are transcribed with the parentheses intact. FILER ERROR retained verbatim: line 4 is labelled 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' but the filer wrote (65.00) there while line 1 Column A is a zero - not corrected. Street address and zip code left blank by the filer on the cover; there is no political-party inconsistency.
